verdict.rationale: Statsig's docs show targeting a feature gate at mobile platforms and internal testers, which is attribute-based targeting. Gates are evaluated deterministically against the user object, and Statsig also supports per-user overrides and target-app scoping. Reusable segments are never explicitly documented in the pack, and the rule-builder evidence is thin. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of reusable segments, detail on the attribute and operator options in targeting rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting.
